jobs.title: Security
jobs.description: Security Limitless Labs Limitless CAM Agent Integrations Siemens NX Mastercam Control Dashboard Security About Newsroom Careers Articles Book a demo Built For The Most Regulated Industries. Your deployment is yours alone. Your data is never shared. Built For The Most Regulated Industries. Your deployment is yours alone. Your data is never shared. A Private Model For Every Customer. Every customer runs in a dedicated tenant with its own encryption keys, storage, and model weights. Programs, toolpaths, CAD geometry, and machining know-how are never used to train our base model and are never shared with anyone else. Single-tenant by default Dedicated storage, dedicated model. No shared inference, no shared embeddings, no neighbours. Encrypted end-to-end AES-256 at rest, TLS 1.2+ in transit, customer-managed keys via AWS KMS on request. No training on your data Your usage data is contractually and technically isolated. It never improves another customer's model. Cloud Or GovCloud. Deploy in the environment your compliance team already trusts — commercial cloud, sovereign region, or GovCloud. Access controls, audit trails and personnel screening adapt to the program you're running. ITAR compliant US Persons-only access, controlled data handling, and export-compliant infrastructure for defense and aerospace work.
